# Functions References {#sec-functions}

# Functions Reference {#sec-packages-functions-reference}

This table consolidates the packages and commands used throughout the book, what each command does, and where it is first introduced.

```{r include=FALSE}
#| inclde: false
library(tibble)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

library(stringr)

ref_trying <- ref_trying |>
  mutate(
    chapter_order = case_when(
      str_detect(`First introduced`, "#sec-intro-key-functions") ~ 1,
      str_detect(`First introduced`, "#sec-tidyverse-key-functions|#sec-loading-packages") ~ 2,
      str_detect(`First introduced`, "#sec-ggplot") ~ 3,
      str_detect(`First introduced`, "#sec-means-key-functions") ~ 4,
      str_detect(`First introduced`, "#sec-anova-key-functions") ~ 5,
      str_detect(`First introduced`, "#sec-cat-analysis-key-functions") ~ 6,
      str_detect(`First introduced`, "#sec-cor-key-functions") ~ 7,
      str_detect(`First introduced`, "#sec-linear-reg-key-functions") ~ 8,
      str_detect(`First introduced`, "#sec-log-reg-key-functions") ~ 9,
      str_detect(`First introduced`, "@r-markdown-keyfunctions") ~ 10,
      TRUE ~ 999
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(chapter_order, Package, Command) |>
  select(-chapter_order)
```
